title: A stack with a menu
summary: Push, pop, top and size on a stack of at most 5 values kept in an array.
hints: Keep `int stack[5]` and `int count` (or pass them to the functions by pointer). `push` and `pop` can return 0 or -1 to say whether they worked.
`while (scanf("%d", &option) == 1 && option != 0)` repeats until `0`; read the value of option 1 inside the loop.
